role: Deputy Director, Office of Federal-State Relations, West Virginia
summary: Robert V. Barill, as Deputy Director of the West Virginia Office of Federal-State Relations, wrote on behalf of the State Clearinghouse to confirm that it had reviewed the Draft Environmental Statement for Implementation of Executive Order #11644 and fully concurred with the memorandum. He certified that the requirements of NEPA Section 102(2)(c) and OMB Circular A-95 had been met. He also noted that comments from David Morgan of the Bureau of Outdoor Recreation's Office of Federal-State Relations were enclosed for further information.

statement.text:
Charleston, West Virginia
FEDERAL STATE RELATIONS
Arch A. Moore, Jr. Governor
July 12, 1972
File: PNRS - BOR
#7206:072
Mr. James G. Watt Director Bureau of Outdoor Recreation Interior Building 18th and C Streets, N. W. Washington, D. C. 20240
Re: Draft Environmental Statement for Implementation of Executive Order 11644
Dear Mr. Watt:
The State Clearinghouse has reviewed the Draft Environmental Statement for Implementation of Executive Order #11644 and concurs fully with this memorandum.
This will certify that the requirements of Section 102(2)(c) of the National Environmental Policy Act of 1969 and the U.S. Office of Management and Budget Circular A-95 have been met.
A copy of the comments of Mr. David Morgan, Planner, Bureau of Outdoor Recreation of the Office of Federal-State Relations is enclosed for your further information.
Sincerely,
Robert V. Barill
Deputy Director
Office of Federal-State Relations
Potat & Bird
RVB: am Encl.
Carl Bradford CC:
Fred Cutlip
David Morgan
